home.welcome: Welcome. Meetings, transcripts and minutes will live here.

account.title: Account
account.everywhereHint: Signs out every computer and phone signed in to your account, this one included.

tiles.headline: Meetings that remember what was said.
tiles.description: Calls with up to 100 people, live captions with names, and minutes in your inbox when the meeting ends.

signIn.title: Sign in to MeetApp
signIn.subtitle: Use your email to sign in.
signIn.legal: By continuing you agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy. Meetings with AI notes show a notice to everyone.
signIn.subtitleProviders: Use your work account, or your email.

password.title: Enter your password
password.subtitle: Or get a one-time code by email instead.
password.label: Password

create.title: Create your account
create.subtitle: Free for individuals and teams.
create.name: Your name
create.nameHint: Shown to people in your meetings.
create.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Avoid common passwords.
create.terms: I agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy, and I am 16 or older.

steps.confirmHint: Type the 6-digit code we email you.
steps.doneHint: Your personal workspace is ready. Create or join a company workspace any time.
steps.footer: Joining a team? Use the email address your invitation was sent to.

code.sentAfter: Type it here to confirm it's you.
code.label: Code
code.hint: Paste works too. Code expires in {{time}}.
code.expired: This code has expired. Send a new code.
code.resent: We sent a new code. The old one no longer works.
code.asideRule: Works for 15 minutes, once. If you didn't ask for it, ignore the email.
code.asideNote: The same code screen confirms a new email, signs you in without a password, and lets you reset a forgotten one.

newPassword.title: Choose a new password
newPassword.label: New password
newPassword.hint: At least 10 characters. Avoid common passwords.
newPassword.note: You'll stay signed in here. Other devices will need the new password.

steps.footer: For your safety, every other computer and phone signed in to your account is signed out after the change.

terms.title: Before you start
terms.body: Accept the Terms and the Privacy Policy to use MeetApp.
terms.agree: I agree to the Terms and the Privacy Policy, and I am 16 or older.

validation.email: Enter a full email address, like aisha@aria.com.
validation.name: Enter your name (at most 60 characters).

errors.network: Can't reach MeetApp. Check your connection.
errors.wrongPassword: Email or password is wrong. Check both, or use a code instead.
errors.codeInvalid: That code isn't right. Check the email, or send a new code.
errors.codeTooManyTries: Too many wrong tries for this code. Send a new code.
errors.codeExpired: This code has expired. Send a new code.
errors.passwordCommon: This password is too common. Choose another one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts, try again in {{minutes}} minute(s).
errors.unverified: Your Google/Microsoft email isn't verified; create an account with your email instead.
errors.workspaceLimit: You can own at most 20 workspaces.
errors.forbidden: Only the owner or an admin can do that.
errors.ownerMustTransfer: Hand the workspace over to someone else before you leave.
errors.invitationGone: This invitation is no longer valid; ask for a new one.
errors.pendingRequest: You've already asked to join. The owner or an admin will decide.
errors.requestExpired: This request is older than 14 days and has expired.
errors.personalWorkspace: Your personal workspace is only for you.
errors.notFound: That is no longer here. The list has been updated.
errors.passwordWrong: That isn't your current password. Try again, or use a code instead.

browser.title: Finish signing in in your browser
browser.body: Your browser opened {{provider}}. Sign in there, then check that the page shows this code:
browser.help: Closed the browser tab? Press Cancel and try again.

switcher.heading: Your workspaces
switcher.join: Join with a link or code

create.title: Create a company workspace
create.description: A shared place for your team's meetings, minutes and AI answers. You'll be its owner.
create.name: Workspace name
create.hint: Usually your company or team name. 2 to 60 characters.
create.nextInvite: Invite teammates by email. Anyone in the workspace can invite others.
create.nextJoin: Or turn on a join link and code. You approve each request to join.
create.nextPersonal: Your personal workspace stays private to you.

notices.removed: You are no longer a member of {{name}}.

people.title: People in {{name}}
people.summary_one: {{count}} person · anyone here can invite others as members.
people.summary_other: {{count}} people · anyone here can invite others as members.

invite.title: Invite by email
invite.hint: They join as soon as they accept. Invitations last 7 days.
invite.empty: Type at least one email address.
invite.tooMany: Send at most {{max}} invitations at a time.
invite.limit: Invite limit reached, try again tomorrow.

link.title: Join link and code
link.description: Anyone signed in who has them can ask to join. You or an admin approves each request.
link.off: The join link is off. The owner or an admin can turn it on.
link.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

confirm.removeText: {{name}} loses access to {{workspace}} at once. What they created stays in the workspace.
confirm.transferText: {{name}} becomes the owner. You become an admin. Only the new owner can undo this.
confirm.leaveText: You lose access at once. What you created stays in the workspace.

requests.title: Requests and invitations
requests.description: People asking to join with the link or code, and invitations waiting for an answer.
requests.noRequests: Nobody is asking to join right now.
requests.footnote: Requests expire after 14 days. Approved people join as members.
requests.noInvitations: No invitations are waiting for an answer.
requests.resent: A new invitation was sent to {{email}}.

join.title: Join a workspace
join.description: Accept an invitation, or use a join link or code from a colleague.
join.noInvitations: No invitations for this email right now.
join.codeTitle: Join with a link or code
join.codeHint: The owner or an admin approves each request.
join.notFound: No workspace found. Check the link or code, or ask for a new one.
join.empty: Paste a join link or type a code.
join.people_one: {{count}} person · you'll join as a member
join.people_other: {{count}} people · you'll join as a member
join.sentText: We'll tell you when the owner or an admin of {{name}} approves it. Requests expire after 14 days.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Seen by people who share a workspace with you.

photo.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Location details are removed.
photo.rule: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 5 MB.

account.title: Account and sign-in
account.passwordHint: Changing it signs out your other devices.
account.noPassword: No password yet. You can set one with a code sent to your email.
account.methodsLinked: {{list}} linked. A code by email always works.
account.methodsNone: A code by email always works.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Your other devices will be signed out. This one stays signed in.
password.done: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

signOut.title: Sign out
signOut.description: Lost a laptop or used a shared computer? Sign out everywhere ends every session, including this one.

data.title: Your data
data.text: To get a copy of your data or delete your account, email {{email}}. We reply within 30 days.
